metric_methodology.CLIPScore: 100 * max(cos(CLIP ViT-B/32 image embedding, CLIP text embedding), 0)
metric_methodology.FID: torchmetrics FrechetInceptionDistance, 2048-d Inception features; unreliable below 2048 images per set
metric_methodology.classifier_accuracy: small CNN trained on real images; generated images of class c are classified; accuracy = fraction labelled c
metric_methodology.AUC/ROC: one-vs-rest per class on the classifier's softmax probabilities; macro AUC = mean over classes
metric_methodology.SSIM/PSNR: only for corresponding image pairs (same content)
